title: Coordinate data and norms for real bundle elliptic estimates
statement: Over $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $N$ be a smooth real $m$-manifold without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], and let $E,F$ be smooth real rank-$r$ vector bundles [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. Use their smooth sections [def-sfb-smooth-bundle-sections]. A smooth coordinate chart is an open partial homeomorphism to $\mathbf R^m$ whose forward and inverse maps are smooth. An orientation is a covering family of such charts with positive transition Jacobian determinants. A positive smooth volume consists of a measure $\mu$ and smooth positive chart densities $\gamma_e$ such that $e_*(\mu|_{\operatorname{source}(e)})=(\gamma_e\,dz)|_{\operatorname{target}(e)}$. A smooth frame is a fibrewise linear bundle trivialization whose map and inverse are smooth. Write $u_{e,f}(z)$ for the frame coefficients of $u(e^{-1}z)$. For $\alpha\in\mathbf N^m$, define $\partial^\alpha$ by applying each coordinate partial derivative $\alpha_j$ times in coordinate order. For an integer $k\geq0$ and a real-linear map $Q:\Gamma^\infty(E)\to\Gamma^\infty(F)$, a local differential expression consists of a smooth chart $e$, smooth frames $f_E,f_F$ defined over its source, and smooth linear-map coefficients $b_\alpha(z)$ for $|\alpha|\leq k$ satisfying $(Qu)_{e,f_F}(z)=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq k}b_\alpha(z)\partial^\alpha u_{e,f_E}(z)$ for every smooth $u$ and every $z$ in the chart target. A bundle differential operator of order at most $k$ has such expressions covering $N$. Its degree-$k$ symbol in each such expression is $\sigma_k(z,\xi)=\sum_{|\alpha|=k}\xi^\alpha b_\alpha(z)$. It is elliptic when all these linear maps are bijective at every nonzero coordinate covector. A localization of $E$ is a finite covering family of smooth charts and smooth frames, and a subordinate smooth partition of unity [lem-sfb-smooth-subordinate-partition] whose functions have compact support inside their chart sources. Extend $\chi_i(e_i^{-1}z)u_{e_i,f_i}(z)$ by zero outside the chart target, calling the result $u_i$. Define $\|u\|_{H^k,A}=\sqrt{\sum_i\sum_{|\alpha|\leq k}\int_{\mathbf R^m}|\partial^\alpha u_i(z)|^2\,dz}$. For a smooth positive definite fibre metric $g$, define $\|u\|_{L^2(g,\mu)}=\sqrt{\int_N g_x(u(x),u(x))\,d\mu(x)}$. These are explicit definitions, not a regularity or estimate assertion.
